theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Health Care (+2.21%) and Real Estate (+1.86%) led the market today, while Energy (-0.50%) and Industrials (-0.10%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.26%, defensives +1.25%, and value/cyclicals +0.52% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.35%, Dow +0.91%, Nasdaq +0.15% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +1.73%, outperforming large caps. The VIX fell 3.91% to 17.71, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 0.43% to $4,147.50, crude oil was little changed at $97.61, and bitcoin gained 0.73% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
